summary.text: Mohamud Noor is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 60B, where Ballotpedia lists the current tenure as beginning in 2019, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists no other candidate in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Mohamud Noor earned a B.S. in computer science from Metropolitan State University.

His experience includes work as executive director of the Confederation of Somali Communities, director of the Minneapolis School Board, and system administrator for Hennepin County and the Minnesota Department of Human Services.
He has also served as a member of the Minnesota Governor's Council of Black Minnesotans and as a union activist for the Minnesota Association of Professional Employees.
Mohamud Noor defeated Abdurrahman Mahmud in the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.

Noor's 2025-2026 committee assignments included the Human Services Finance and Policy Committee (as Co-Chair), the House Higher Education Finance and Policy Committee and the Ways and Means Committee.
